## Checklist

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/prisant-labs/typora-plugin-favorite-folders-files/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#make-a-change) for each step.

- [ ] Tests were written or updated before the code; `pnpm test:run` and `pnpm typecheck` pass.
- [ ] For a visible change: `pnpm prototype:build` was run, and the preview page was tried in light and dark themes.
- [ ] For a visible change: `pnpm docs:screenshots` was run, and every rewritten image was looked at.
- [ ] User-visible changes are under `## Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`; the README and the user guide match.
- [ ] Behavior that only Typora can show has steps in `test/native/README.md`.
- [ ] `pnpm privacy:check` passed on the staged changes. No real paths, names or Recent entries are included.
- [ ] The version is unchanged. Releases have their own pull request.
- [ ] New settings are saved outside the Favorites preferences in the `current` record.
